candidates.description: RPM Platform offers a cost-effective and seamless solution for clinical and at-risk stakeholders across the continuum: Physicians and Qualified Healthcare, Professionals, Acute Hospitals, Skilled Nursing Facilities, Certified Home, ACO, PACE, IPA, Healthcare Agencies, and Senior Housing Communities.
candidates.rationale: Related healthcare software, but Chronica is RPM infrastructure for providers; Teladoc is consumer-facing virtual care and clinician network platform.

candidates.name: Equum Medical
candidates.description: Equum Medical is a leading provider of telehealth solutions, specializing in comprehensive acute virtual care services that integrate seamlessly into existing healthcare frameworks. Founded with a vision to enhance healthcare accessibility and efficacy, Equum Medical leverages innovative technologies and a deep clinical expertise to deliver telehealth services that are both scalable and sustainable. Our mission is to empower healthcare organizations to overcome critical challenges such as staffing shortages, geographic barriers to care, and escalating healthcare costs. Equum Medical offers a full spectrum of telehealth solutions that support a continuity framework through a virtual dimension from ED to Discharge, with Multi-Specialty Providers, Critical Care, Virtual Nursing, Sitter and Telemetry.
candidates.rationale: Both are telehealth providers serving healthcare organizations with virtual care services, overlapping in buyer persona and category.

candidates.name: TeleMed2U
candidates.description: TeleMed2U is a leading specialty care company, focused on leveraging technology and end to end patient services to provide quality affordable care. With over 275 specialist care providers in 20 specialties, TeleMed2U has grown to manage over 2 million lives with end-to-end patient care, ensuring high continuity of care for recurring patients by providing access to a single, sustained, patient care team. Since founding in 2011, TeleMed2U’s transformational multispecialty patient care platform, provides specialty telehealth solutions to businesses like primary care physicians, payor networks, health systems and employer groups as well as a direct patient platform, making access to an array of specialties ranging from mental health to infectious diseases readily available to the patient. Our clinical team is made up of experts with decades of experience, passionate about combining technology and quality care to offer the best experience for our patients.
candidates.rationale: Both are telehealth platforms offering virtual specialty and chronic care services to similar healthcare and employer buyers.

candidates.name: Celly Health Medical Group
candidates.description: At Celly Health, we blend the health of both mind and body with cutting-edge technology and evidence-based options. You’ll receive care from seasoned professionals dedicated to providing personalized, compassionate, and accessible healthcare.
candidates.rationale: Looks like a small healthcare provider/medical group, not a telehealth platform like Teladoc.

candidates.name: Revive
candidates.description: Employers are investing more than ever in healthcare. Most of it goes unused. Revive was built to change that. We create a care experience people turn to—bringing primary and urgent care, mental health, pharmacy, and weight health into one connected, virtual-first model that fits into everyday life. The result is simple: higher engagement, lower costs, and better outcomes. Because healthcare only works if people actually use it.
candidates.rationale: Both are virtual-first healthcare platforms offering telehealth, primary/urgent care, and chronic/mental health services to similar buyers.

candidates.name: Rumini Health
candidates.description: Rumini is a 100% Canadian-owned telehealth leader, dedicated to helping Canadians manage lifestyle-related conditions empowering healthier, happier lives across the country. Rumini is not a pharmacy or a manufacturer of medical substances.
candidates.rationale: Both are telehealth providers offering virtual care and chronic-condition support to similar patient populations.

candidates.name: Dialogue
candidates.description: Dialogue is Canada's only virtual care provider with Accreditation Canada Exemplary Standing — the highest standard of safety, quality, and member experience in the industry. We deliver integrated health and wellness services through a single platform, from the convenience of a smartphone, computer, or tablet: Primary Care, Mental Health+, EAP, Women's Health, Wellness, and Medical Second Opinion. One app. One in-house care team. Available 24/7/365. With a 4.8/5 app rating, 4.7/5 appointment satisfaction, and a 9.4/10 onboarding satisfaction score, Dialogue is the benefits partner that stands behind its results — for the 52,000 organizations that choose it, and more than 10 million Canadians who depend on it.
candidates.rationale: Direct virtual-care/telehealth provider with similar platform, customers, and buyer persona; closely overlaps Teladoc’s market.

candidates.name: Visit Health
candidates.description: With a background in emergency medical response, Visit Health remains at the forefront of customized patient care by providing medical and occupational health solutions, mental health support, and recovery treatment programming for patients and employers nationwide.
candidates.rationale: Healthcare services provider, not a telehealth platform; different business model and buyer use case than Teladoc.

candidates.name: HealthAssure
candidates.description: HealthAssure is India’s largest Primary Healthcare aggregator with a comprehensive network of 4,500+ centres, set up across 1,300+ cities. Founded in 2011, it aspires to make healthcare and wellness accessible and comprehensible for both corporates and individuals across the country through it's endeavour to create a healthier tomorrow. HealthAssure is consumerising healthcare by designing network-based primary healthcare products. It offers a diverse range of services through a fully integrated, digitized platform that addresses the varying needs of the diverse stakeholders. From finding a healthcare provider to booking an appointment, in-person, online and telephonic doctor consultations, health check-ups, home care services, lab testing, doctor coaches, fitness trainers and gyms - it provides the entire spectrum of primary care experience. HealthAssure actively engages with organisations, including Fortune 500 companies for end-to-end management of employees, assessment of healthcare gaps/risks, and providing access to a high-quality, trusted and discounted primary care network. HealthAssure also services top insurance companies to help their customers with pre-policy check-ups and other diagnosis. In line with the company's philosophy to cover the journey from 'Illness to Wellness', HealthAssure recently acquired FitMeIn - an on-demand fitness subscription service in May 2020. With this, it will integrate the offerings of both the brands under a single umbrella thereby extending their services from primary care to include preventive care through fitness and lifestyle choices. The company has extended its services to more than 2mn+ customers and targets to serve millions more in the coming year. The application is available as a web portal - www.healthassure.in and as a mobile app across iOS/Android.
candidates.rationale: Primary-care/telehealth platform serving patients and employers, similar digital healthcare buyer base and service model to Teladoc.

candidates.name: Aiqa health
candidates.description: At aiqa health, we are on a mission to revolutionize healthcare access by making it Affordable, Inclusive, Quality, and Accessible for underserved communities across Bharat. Leveraging the power of technology, we bridge the gaps in healthcare accessibility, affordability, and awareness, ensuring no one has to choose between health and livelihood. Founded with a vision to simplify healthcare, aiqa health is co-led by industry pioneers, including Sunil Sachdeva, co-founder of Medanta Hospital. With deep expertise in healthcare and technology, we aim to make healthcare a right, not a privilege. Our platform offers an API-led, scalable solution that empowers B2C companies, partners, and resellers to embed affordable health and insurance products into their offerings. Our Vision is to enable a future where affordable and accessible healthcare is a reality for every Indian, regardless of geography or income level.
candidates.rationale: Both are tech-enabled healthcare access platforms offering virtual/embedded care services to similar patient and partner buyers.

candidates.name: Direct2Care
candidates.description: We offer your employees virtual healthcare with direct, 24/7 access to board-certified medical providers. Instead of missing work to schedule an appointment, commute and wait in a doctor's office, your employees can see a provider when it's convenient for them – either off-hours or during a break at work. With an average wait time of only 10 minutes, patients will save time, money and gas.
candidates.rationale: Direct2Care is a virtual care/telehealth provider serving employers, closely matching Teladoc’s core business and buyer base.

candidates.name: Humaniti
candidates.description: At Humaniti, we deliver on-demand medical care from certified, trusted professionals directly to you - at home, the office, or wherever you may be. We are fundamentally changing the healthcare model by bringing doctors to people, not the other way around. Our mission is to remove the traditional barriers of time, distance, and inconvenience, offering quality care that fits into your life, rather than disrupting it. For Individuals & Families: We provide peace of mind when you need it most. Whether it's a child's midnight fever, a consultation for a busy professional who can't step away from work, or compassionate support for caregivers, Humaniti brings expert medical care and comfort to you in your most vulnerable moments. For Medical Professionals: We empower doctors to practice medicine with greater purpose, flexibility, and freedom. Our platform enables practitioners to heal beyond clinic walls, reduce administrative burdens, and restore the vital human touch in medicine. Humaniti is more than an app; we are pioneering a new, more accessible era of healthcare. We're building a future where quality medical care is always within reach. Humaniti. Healthcare, anywhere.
candidates.rationale: Same telehealth/on-demand care model and similar patient-facing healthcare buyer persona; Humaniti is a clear Teladoc lookalike.

candidates.name: April Health
candidates.description: We are a fully-integrated, turnkey behavioral health solution that partners with primary care providers to improve patient outcomes, reduce provider burden, and generate new revenue streams for your practice. Through a combination of human led support and 24/7 access to our AI digital therapeutic, our care leads to best in class patient engagement and outcomes.
candidates.rationale: Both are healthcare technology platforms offering virtual, clinically managed care solutions to providers and patients.

candidates.name: MedOne Healthcare Partners
candidates.description: MedOne Hospital Physicians is a team of more than 160 physicians and advanced practice clinicians who are united by a single purpose - to make healthcare better. It's been our mission from day one, and we are relentless in our pursuit to improve the delivery of high-quality care for our patients and our partners. Founded in 2000, MedOne has grown to be the largest hospital medicine practice in central Ohio, while continuing to expand our expertise to meet the ever-changing needs of those we serve. Today, we provide expert: -Acute Hospital Medicine Programs -Post-Acute Care -Pre-Admission Testing -Staffing Solutions -Hospital Medicine Consulting We are honored to be designated a Best Place to Work by Columbus Business First in 2019, 2020, and 2021.
candidates.rationale: Hospital medicine staffing and consulting provider, not a telehealth/virtual care platform like Teladoc.
